title: Product repo.harness.json
description: Declares project layout and canonical apps/* names. Required at every project/shared root. Apps must be from the portfolio allowlist (webapp, docapp, extapp, admapp, jobapp, wuiapp, muiapp, mobapp, vidapp, imgapp, pgboss, studio). Forbidden: web, docs, example, mobile, flat-root Next as the project app. Shipped by @sargonpiraev/eslint-config.

layout.description: turbo = project monorepo with apps/; turbo-lib = shared/lib monorepo (apps optional). Flat-root Next project apps are forbidden.

apps.description: Directory names under apps/. Must match disk (enforced by ESLint rule). Empty only for turbo-lib without apps.
